title: REV-65: Report the private sales pipeline and escalate failures before revenue
body:
## Problem and result

Sales decisions need honest queue, delivery, cost, and failure visibility before the first sale. Add private operational reporting and immediate owner escalation, then enrich it with revenue/margin evidence when a paid lane exists rather than blocking reports on commercial qualification.

## Source and scope

[Revenue roadmap](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/sales/revenue-roadmap.md#parallel-sales-floor-build) REV-65 and [Sales-floor contract](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/sales/agent-sales-floor.md) define this slice. Project canonical [REV-53 (#10860)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10860) records and [REV-58 (#10861)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10861) reservations through `crates/coder/src/task/`, `crates/openagents-cli`, and existing agent panels. Wendy's future wrapper may consume the same report; use one host projection, not another analytics store.

- [ ] Report stage counts, accepted assignments, next actions/dates, drafted/approved/sent/replied messages, meetings, certification, and unresolved work.
- [ ] Keep confirmed delivery, bounce, unknown delivery, opt-out, complaint, and absent telemetry separate.
- [ ] Expose list-price reservations/estimates, known actual bills, unknown cost, and model/sending cost per qualified lead.
- [ ] Deliver complaints and pause/suspension/authentication/budget/adversary failures promptly to owner review with exact evidence references.
- [ ] Produce Paul's weekly aggregate draft with lessons and proposed next actions; publishing remains an exact owner decision.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Private pipeline and critical escalation work with zero revenue and with financial adapters absent.
- [ ] Projection totals reproduce canonical records after restart; duplicate attempts or replies do not inflate results.
- [ ] Unknown expense or low-volume telemetry is labeled unknown, not zero or successful operation.
- [ ] Financial enrichment distinguishes gross collections, earned OpenAgents revenue, top-ups, third-party shares, reversals, and full delivery/support costs.
- [ ] A report cannot disclose another assignment or turn draft counts, pilot agreements, model claims, or XP into sales.

## Dependencies

Mandatory: [REV-54 (#10865)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10865) and [REV-58 (#10861)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10861). Conditional: [REV-62 (#10869)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10869)/[REV-63 (#10870)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10870) supply outbound metrics; [REV-25 (#10832)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10832)/[REV-26 (#10833)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10833) supply financial/funnel enrichment. Their absence is visible and does not block pre-revenue reports. Shared public projections use [REV-71 (#10878)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10878); no full Wendy agent or optional relay telemetry is required.

## Verification

Test projection recomputation, deduplication, unknown values, unauthorized reads, zero-revenue operation, and prompt failure alerts. Run formatting and targeted tests for edited canonical records, `coder`, CLI, and view crates. Use scratch `HOME`, host/task roots, file keys, and injected adapters; never touch the owner's host/keychain/units/pairing. Archive scratch Coder tasks. Run heavy Cargo commands through the build lease with a long-lived target directory. No GitHub workflows or full release gate.

## Activation and closure

Keep human-led R0/R1 independent. Close after scoped checks, merge, and required deploy pass. Track owner-only credentials, real-contact/funded qualification, legal/commercial decisions, and activation in `NEEDS_OWNER.md`; they never hold code-complete implementation open. Fixtures never authorize a campaign.

## Roadmap and dependency registration

Stable roadmap ID: **REV-65**. [Unified revenue roadmap](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/sales/revenue-roadmap.md#build-issue-list).

Native completion blockers: #10865, #10861

Roadmap dependency scope, including conditional branches and reused foundations: [REV-54 (#10865)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10865), [REV-58 (#10861)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10861); [REV-62 (#10869)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10869)/[REV-63 (#10870)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10870) for outbound metrics; [REV-25 (#10832)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10832)/[REV-26 (#10833)](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/issues/10833) for financial enrichment

Conditional integration branches are implemented when enabled; alternatives select one product lane. A reused closed foundation, optional relay telemetry, or owner-only activation is not a new native completion blocker. Claim this issue before implementation and maintain the project status. Close after scoped code/artifacts, focused checks, merge to main, and any required host deploy are complete; record owner-only qualification/activation in `NEEDS_OWNER.md`.
